active_schemes.title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
active_schemes.benefit_summary: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank accounts via DBT.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card linked with Bank Account
active_schemes.description: Income support to all landholding farmer families across the country to assist in procuring agricultural inputs and domestic needs.

active_schemes.title: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (Micro Irrigation Subsidy)
active_schemes.benefit_summary: 55% subsidy on Drip/Sprinkler systems for Small & Marginal farmers; 45% subsidy for other farmers.
required_documents: Water Source Availability Certificate / Well proof
active_schemes.description: Promotes micro-irrigation technologies (Drip & Sprinkler) to improve farm water use efficiency and enhance crop productivity.

active_schemes.title: PM-KUSUM (Solar Agricultural Pump Subsidy)
active_schemes.provider: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
active_schemes.benefit_summary: Up to 60% subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) for standalone solar agriculture pumps (3HP, 5HP, 7.5HP). Farmer pays only 10-40%.
required_documents: Affidavit of No Existing Electric Tubewell Connection
active_schemes.description: Enables farmers to install solar-powered irrigation pumps, replacing diesel pumps and ensuring uninterrupted daylight irrigation.

active_schemes.title: SMAM (Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization)
active_schemes.benefit_summary: 40% to 50% subsidy on rotavators, power tillers, laser land levelers, seed drills, and custom hiring centers.
required_documents: Quotation / Proforma Invoice from Authorized Dealer
Caste Certificate (if SC/ST/OBC for additional 10% benefit)
active_schemes.description: Financial assistance to purchase farm implements to increase mechanization, reduce labor dependency, and boost harvest speed.

active_schemes.title: Punjab DSR (Direct Seeding of Rice) Incentive
active_schemes.benefit_summary: Direct cash incentive of ₹1,500 per acre for adopting direct seeding of rice instead of puddle transplantation.
required_documents: Geo-tagged Verification Photo by Agriculture Officer
active_schemes.description: Encourages water conservation in Punjab by replacing traditional flood-irrigation paddy transplanting with Direct Seeded Rice technology.

active_schemes.title: Haryana - Mera Pani Meri Virasat (Crop Diversification)
active_schemes.benefit_summary: Financial assistance of ₹7,000 per acre to farmers who switch from water-guzzling paddy to alternative crops.
required_documents: Meri Fasal Mera Byora (MFMB) Registration ID
active_schemes.description: Financial incentive to shift acreage away from paddy towards cotton, maize, pulses, or horticulture to save underground water tables.

active_schemes.title: Uttar Pradesh - Beej Gram Yojana (Certified Seed Subsidy)
active_schemes.benefit_summary: 50% direct subsidy on certified high-yielding foundation seeds for small and marginal farmers.
required_documents: UP Agriculture Department DBT Registration Number
Kisan Credit Card (KCC) or Land Fard
active_schemes.description: Distribution of certified foundation seeds of high-yielding crop varieties at 50% discount to upgrade farm productivity.

active_schemes.title: Maharashtra - Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban
active_schemes.benefit_summary: Up to ₹2,50,000 for digging new farm wells, ₹50,000 for solar/electric pumps, and ₹50,000 for micro-irrigation.
active_schemes.subsidy_rate: Up to 100% for Selected Eligible Components
active_schemes.description: Special assistance package providing irrigation facilities, new dug wells, in-well bore, and pump sets for sustainable agriculture.

active_schemes.title: Soil Health Card Scheme (Free Soil Testing & Micronutrient Subsidy)
active_schemes.benefit_summary: 100% free comprehensive soil test (12 nutrients) + 50% subsidy on recommended bio-fertilizers and gypsum.
active_schemes.description: Issues customized soil health cards assessing 12 macro/micronutrients and gives dosage advice to cut fertilizer costs by 20%.
